SELECT homepage_id, terms_idx, terms_type, manage_idx, title, contents, use_yn, required_yn, delete_yn, add_id, add_date, modify_id, modify_date, (SELECT A.CODE_NAME FROM CMS_CODE A WHERE A.GROUP_ID = 'C0015' AND A.CODE_ID = CMS_TERMS.TERMS_TYPE) AS TERMS_TYPE_NAME FROM CMS_TERMS WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND terms_idx = #{terms_idx} AND DELETE_YN = 'N'
mapper.insert:
SELECT NVL(MAX(terms_idx),0)+1 FROM CMS_TERMS
INSERT INTO CMS_TERMS ( homepage_id, TERMS_IDX, TERMS_TYPE, manage_idx, TITLE, CONTENTS, USE_YN, REQUIRED_YN, DELETE_YN, ADD_ID, ADD_DATE ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, #{terms_idx}, #{terms_type}, #{manage_idx}, #{title}, #{contents}, #{use_yn}, #{required_yn}, 'N', #{add_id}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE CMS_TERMS SET DELETE_YN = 'Y' WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND terms_idx = #{terms_idx}
mapper.select: SELECT terms_idx, title, contents, required_yn FROM CMS_TERMS A, CMS_CODE B, WB_MODULE_MNGT C WHERE A.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND A.use_yn = 'Y' AND A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.terms_type = b.code_id AND B.group_id = 'C0015' AND B.use_yn = 'Y' AND B.code_id = C.terms_group_id AND C.module_idx = #{module_idx} ORDER BY terms_idx

SELECT TERMS_IDX, TERMS_TYPE, TITLE, CONTENTS, USE_YN, DELETE_YN, ADD_ID, TO_CHAR(ADD_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ADD_DATE, MODIFY_ID, MODIFY_DATE, (SELECT A.CODE_NAME FROM CMS_CODE A WHERE A.GROUP_ID = 'C0015' AND A.CODE_ID = CMS_TERMS.TERMS_TYPE) AS TERMS_TYPE_NAME FROM CMS_TERMS WHERE TERMS_IDX NOT IN (SELECT TERMS_IDX FROM CMS_MODULE_TERMS WHERE MODULE_IDX = #{module_idx}) AND DELETE_YN = 'N' AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT title, contents FROM CMS_TERMS A, CMS_CODE B, CMS_BOARD_MANAGE C WHERE A.homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND A.use_yn = 'Y' AND A.delete_yn = 'N' AND A.terms_type = b.code_id AND A.manage_idx = #{manage_idx} AND B.group_id = 'C0015' AND B.use_yn = 'Y' AND B.code_id = 6 AND C.terms_yn = 'Y' AND C.manage_idx = #{manage_idx} ORDER BY terms_idx

SELECT terms_idx, title, required_yn FROM CMS_TERMS WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND delete_yn = 'N' AND terms_idx IN ( SELECT SUBSTR(terms, INSTR(terms, ',', 1, LEVEL) + 1, INSTR(terms, ',', 1, LEVEL + 1) - INSTR(terms, ',', 1, LEVEL) - 1) AS terms FROM ( SELECT ',' || terms || ',' AS terms FROM TEACH WHERE delete_yn = 'N' AND homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND teach_idx = #{teach_idx} AND category_idx = #{category_idx} AND group_idx = #{group_idx} ) CONNECT BY LEVEL <= LENGTH(terms) - LENGTH(REPLACE(terms, ',')) - 1 )
